name: Hornero System Monitor
description: System Monitor 2.0: dashboard card over the shared PluginKit System facade with the 1.x usage bars plus in-card session history, peak/average readouts and a high-load alert. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Dashboard card on the shared System facade: 1.x bars plus session history sparkline, peak/average, high-load alert, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card with CPU, memory, GPU and storage usage bars from the PluginKit System service.

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a row is flagged as high. Adds an alert chip only; 1.x had no threshold.

showTemperatures.description: Show CPU/GPU temperatures when the System service reports them (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the in-card session history sampled from the shared System facade while the card is loaded.

sampleSeconds.description: Seconds between history samples read from the already-live shared System facade.
